A food item which restores {{Energy||18-}} {{Energy||30}} and applies the slow metabolism buff when consumed.  It must be made in the [[oven]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect.  For the main page on preparing food, see [[cooking]].

The recipe [[Recipe tasty and healthy]] can be bought from [[Miss Chain]] in [[The Dead Horse]] for {{Silver Coin}}5 {{Copper Coin}}40.

==Effect==

On use, a baked pumpkin will apply the slow metabolism buff for a duration of 2 minutes, extending the duration of all other buffs. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
